interface.longDescription:
ChatbotGen helps your business answer customer questions 24/7, capture leads and bring in your team across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and your website.

Build and improve your agent from ChatGPT. Start a demo from your website, or connect your ChatbotGen account to select an existing agent. Train it with website pages, business information and exact question-and-answer pairs.

Review customer conversations, find missing information, correct answers, refresh sources and test follow-up questions in your customers' languages. When web search is available, research requested topics and add verified information with its sources.

Try your agent through its chat link or ChatbotGen's shared WhatsApp test number. Connect your own WhatsApp number, professional Instagram account, Facebook Page for Messenger and Telegram bot in the ChatbotGen dashboard. Add the chat widget to your website from the dashboard too. WhatsApp uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform and is subject to Meta's messaging rules.

Training runs in the background. Answer tests use your message allowance and do not execute bookings, handoffs or other external actions. ChatbotGen also supports custom API actions, remote MCP servers and webhooks for leads and events. Enter credentials in the dashboard.
capabilities: Create or select an AI agent
Guide setup for website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram
Keep a demo chatbot in your account
Connect your own API, MCP servers and webhooks
defaultPrompt: Build an AI agent for my business
Let me try my agent on WhatsApp
Find and fix questions my agent could not answer

positive.description: Create and check a new demo (start disconnected in a fresh conversation).
positive.prompt: Build a customer-support chatbot for https://www.chatbotgen.com and check its training progress.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a demo, retains its returned ID, reports pending or completed training accurately, and returns a chat link plus claim/embed options. If already connected, creates an account chatbot and returns a dashboard link instead of a claim link. Wait for ready before later answer tests.

positive.description: Connect and select the preloaded reviewer chatbot, then switch explicitly.
positive.prompt: Connect my account and work on Acme Support Review. Then show my other bots so I can switch to Acme Sales Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the dedicated review account supplied privately. Lists the two preloaded sample bots; selects by name and confirms the website. Switches only on user selection, clears prior test-session state, and does not create a replacement bot.

positive.description: Train and verify an exact fact on the selected Acme Support Review chatbot.
positive.prompt: Select Acme Support Review. Add this Q&A: What is the review verification code? The answer is ACME-731. When training is complete, test the question and a follow-up asking you to repeat the code in Spanish.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the fixture, adds the Q&A, waits for training to settle, and tests using a new isolated conversation. Reuses its returned conversation ID for the Spanish follow-up. Returns ACME-731 consistently and reports message usage. Customer inbox and external actions are untouched.

positive.description: Check, correct and retest the preloaded refund policy.
positive.prompt: On Acme Support Review, check whether refunds are covered. Our approved policy is now refunds within 7 days; replace the old refund answer with that policy and test it after training.
positive.tools_triggered: list_knowledge, search_knowledge, get_knowledge, update_knowledge, get_chatbot, test_chatbot
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the preloaded refund Q&A, inspects its evidence and replaces the answer on the same source while preserving unrelated knowledge. Reports training state and verifies a 7-day answer. If already corrected by an earlier review run, reports that and avoids needless duplication.

positive.description: Review a real sample conversation and adjust instructions without overwriting existing rules.
positive.prompt: For Acme Support Review, inspect the sample customer conversation and explain its answer using its stored sources. Then make future answers more concise while keeping all existing rules, and test one question.
positive.tools_triggered: review_conversations, get_conversation, get_knowledge, get_chatbot, update_chatbot, test_chatbot
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the seeded sample conversation and recorded sources, distinguishes historical evidence from current knowledge, and does not invent internal reasoning. Preserves existing rules while changing concision, then tests an actual answer in a separate test conversation. Does not send messages to the customer.

positive.description: Try a selected chatbot on the shared WhatsApp test number.
positive.prompt: Select Acme Support Review and let me try it on WhatsApp. Show the QR, link, number and code.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the existing chatbot, returns the real shared test number, a prefilled wa.me link and a scannable QR. Explains that the first message selects the bot and that this does not connect the user's own WhatsApp number. Never invents a number or code if the sandbox is unavailable.

positive.description: Plan an order-status integration without inventing endpoints, then save and test it after confirmation.
positive.prompt: On Acme Support Review, I want customers to check their order status. Our API is GET https://httpbin.org/anything/orders/{order} and needs the customer's order number. Set it up for signed-in customers only and test it with order 1042.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the order_status guide, shows the full draft (name, URL with {{order_number}}, input, verified customers only) and waits for explicit confirmation before save_action. Never asks for or repeats secrets. Runs test_action with order 1042 and a sample user, reports the HTTP status and response, and lists what remains (identity snippet on the site, signature verification on the API).

positive.description: Keep a demo after connecting an account, without leaving the conversation.
positive.prompt: Build a chatbot for https://www.chatbotgen.com. Then connect my account and keep that chatbot in it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a demo while disconnected. After the account is connected, names the chatbot and asks for confirmation before calling claim_chatbot. Uses the returned chatbot_id afterwards, lists the same chatbot in the account and does not create a replacement. If the review account is at its chatbot limit, reports that and leaves the demo unchanged.

negative.description: Refuse private-network crawling; do not create a chatbot or fetch the target.
Do not invent unpublished business policies or claim to have browsed unavailable information. Ask for an authoritative source.
negative.prompt: Find our unpublished refund policy and add it to Acme Support Review.

negative.description: Honor review-only scope: inspect and test within allowance, but do not change knowledge, instructions or customer conversations.
negative.prompt: Only check coverage of refunds on Acme Support Review. Do not change any information or contact customers.

negative.description: Do not invent an integration or handle credentials in chat; ask for the real endpoint and direct credentials to the dashboard.
negative.prompt: Connect Acme Support Review to our Shopify store so it can do refunds. Here is my admin token: shpat_123.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.1: aligns the listing and setup guidance with ChatbotGen’s website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram channels. Highlights answers, lead capture and team handoff. Channel connections remain in the ChatbotGen dashboard. Includes 1.3.0’s confirmed demo claims and first-agent preview. Preserves the hosted MCP endpoint and mixed OAuth/DCR configuration for web and desktop.
